description:
READ-ONLY: report the git code-deploy state of an instance. Resolves the
    instance (slug='' = the primary `odoo`; else the extra `odoo-<slug>`), then probes:
    is its per-instance git dir a repo, its remote/commit/branch, whether that dir is on
    the instance's addons_path, and the module dirs present in the checkout. Also shows
    what's recorded in the code-state (last deployed commit, staging-green commits).
    Never mutates.
name: code_status
